subject: Request: discretionary sign-on + retroactive equity refresh for Staff Infra candidate
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request: discretionary sign-on + retroactive equity refresh for Staff Infra candidate

Team —

I'm requesting a one-time discretionary package to close on Priyanka Rao (Staff, Infrastructure). Quick context: Priyanka is a passive candidate we chased after she left a strong infra platform lead role at Clearstream. She completed final loop last week and is verbally excited to join, but her competing offer includes a larger up-front cash component and a slightly higher equity grant.

Proposal (summary):
- Base: within band (no change)
- Sign-on: $40,000 (one-time) — exceeds typical sign-on cap for the band
- Equity: refresh to match market — grant size equivalent to 25% uplift versus band midpoint, with 1.5x vesting acceleration clause (candidate requested) — this is outside standard refresh window

Why I recommend:
- Rare infra talent with distributed systems + L7 mentoring experience; will shorten time-to-value on critical reliability work.
- Salary parity maintained; this is targeted at close risk only.
- We have budget in hiring plan Q4 to accommodate one-off sign-ons at this level if approved.

Attachments: draft offer (PDF) and comp-band benchmark (xlsx).

Ask: Rishi — please confirm comp/legal viability and any payroll/finance flags.
Markus — please confirm this is mission-critical and warrants out-of-band equity terms.
Laura/Tessa — if approved, can we get an expedited DocuSign link and a note we can share with candidate this week?

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Sr. Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary sign-on + retroactive equity refresh for Staff Infra candidate

Chloe —

Thanks for the write-up and attachments. A few clarifying Qs before I can sign off: 

1) Can you confirm total OTE impact year-1 (base + sign-on + PR accounting for the equity uplift)? I want to confirm we stay within the hiring budget override you mentioned.
2) What is the business justification for 1.5x vesting acceleration? It creates precedent that we should document tightly.
3) Any immigration/payroll complications with a non-US hire (Priyanka is US-based per recruiter?)

Markus, if you can confirm product/impact and the necessity for the accelerated vesting I can model the comp/stock impact in the comp-band sheet and return with options (e.g., increase sign-on versus equity uplift).

Cc'ing Laura for HR/approvals workflow.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Total Compensation, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 13:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary sign-on + retroactive equity refresh for Staff Infra candidate

Chloe / team —

I support the request. Quick rationale: Priyanka led a storage reliability rewrite at Clearstream that directly maps to a high-priority project on our roadmap (persistent KV cache consistency + cross-region failover). The earliest estimate is 4-6 months to unblock multiple outages and reduce customer P99 latency for backups. The comp ask is heavy but targeted to avoid losing her to an early competitor.

If Rishi is comfortable with either the $40k sign-on + smaller equity uplift or a split (e.g., $25k sign-on + 15% uplift) I'm flexible. The vesting acceleration request is negotiable but I want a commitment on 12-months minimum tenure clause.

- Markus
VP, Infrastructure Engineering

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary sign-on + retroactive equity refresh for Staff Infra candidate

Thanks all — a few operational notes from the talent side: 

- Candidate is US-based, ready to sign within 48 hours, and has a 2-week notice period.
- Priyanka explicitly prefers more up-front cash vs. long-term equity; sign-on is the stronger lever to close quickly.
- She asked for the 1.5x acceleration only to offset perceived risk from leaving mid-cycle; she'd accept a 12-month accelerated vesting + 12-month retention claw if we prefer.

I can draft two final offer variants for Rishi's modeling:
A) $40k sign-on + 10% equity uplift (no acceleration)
B) $25k sign-on + 25% uplift + 12-month acceleration + retention claw

If Rishi/law are OK, I can create DocuSign drafts and include a short hiring-commitment addendum.

— Tessa
Senior Recruiting Partner

Date: Mon, 17 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: discretionary package confirmed (finance routing)

Chloe / team —

I've reviewed and approved the discretionary package with the following constraints: 
- Final variant selected: Option B (25k sign-on + 25% equity uplift + 12-month acceleration + 12-month retention claw).
- HR will not approve 1.5x vesting acceleration; 12-month acceleration with claw is acceptable.
- Please include a 12-month minimum employment clause and the retention claw language in the offer.

Next steps:
1) Tessa — prepare the DocuSign (use the corporate template + addendum) and share link with Chloe + Priyanka.
2) Chloe — when candidate signs, route a copy to finance@redwood.com for payroll provisioning and to compops@redwood.com for equity modeling.

Attaching the reviewed draft offer and comp-band sheet (redlines noted).

Thanks — this has my sign-off for payroll and equity ops to process.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
